	 * Used to provide a list of aliases when using the help commands

	public static final Map<String, Set<String>> INVERTED_ALIASES = CATEGORY_ALIASES

		.stream()
		.collect(
			Collectors.groupingBy(
				item -> item.getValue().toString(),
				Collectors.mapping(
					Map.Entry::getKey,
					Collectors.toSet()
				)
			)
		);
